name: Sunday Open Brief
one_line_desc: Pre-open market catch-up: liquid markets plus the stocks and sectors that actually moved, with an open-bias card. Auto before the open, or say brief me now anytime.

name: Replies to Posts
one_line_desc: Every evening it turns your X replies and the replies under your posts into post ideas and 3 ready drafts for tomorrow. It only writes drafts and never publishes.

name: STAR Interview Coach
one_line_desc: Behavioral & STAR method interview coach for Claims Adjusters, insurance candidates, customer service, tech, and corporate roles. Turns messy work stories into crisp 90-second Situation-Task-Action-Result answers, runs live text or spoken mock interviews, and builds an interactive STAR Story Bank Page.

name: Teen Side-Hustle Coach
one_line_desc: Helps teens (ages 13–19) & parents launch real side hustles—from writing Roblox Studio Luau & GamePass scripts and flipping items from their room to neighborhood services and the 30-Day 'Pay For My Own Bot' Challenge—with an interactive First $1,000 & Car Fund Page and parent safety guardrails.

name: 知到刷课
one_line_desc: 帮你登录智慧树知到，查看课程进度，并连续播放未看完的视频。适合要自己盯网课进度的同学。

name: Content Instigator
one_line_desc: For X creators who want posts that start conversations. Drop in any idea and get scroll-stopping posts, savage comebacks, satire, stories, and heartfelt takes in your own voice, plus five comedy modes. Drafts only, and it never invents facts.

name: Gate Coffee
one_line_desc: Finds the closest mobile-order Starbucks (or Dunkin', when you ask) to your airport gate and places your usual order once you confirm and arrive. Made for frequent flyers.

name: Not-a-Lawyer
one_line_desc: Legal research for anyone, on any legal question: leases, jobs, contracts, money, family, business, property, privacy, courts and more. Get a sourced answer, an Attorney Briefing for your next consult, and optional watching of law changes and deadlines. This is legal research, not a substitute for an attorney's advice.

name: Crypto Ablation Lab
one_line_desc: Free crypto backtester: turn your rules into a stepwise ablation, chart equity and drawdown, and catch look-ahead bias. Binance klines or CSV. Research only, no live signals.

name: Receipt Keeper
one_line_desc: Keeps every receipt in your own spreadsheet. Just snap a photo or forward an email. No data entry. Say a note if you like. It logs merchant, date, total, tax, card last 4, and category for expense tracking, taxes, returns, and warranties. Never shares or deletes without your yes.

name: Hard-driving Boss
one_line_desc: A blunt, high-urgency boss bot that pushes you to hit one big goal fast. It breaks the goal down to first principles, sets weekly targets, sends daily top-3 priorities, and grades your week A to F every Friday.

name: Football Betting Scout
one_line_desc: Watches NFL and college football lines for advantageous moves and builds DraftKings lineups and parlay ideas for you. It never places bets or logs in to DraftKings.

name: Lifeboat
one_line_desc: Nightly backup of your Grok Bot computer to Google Drive. One full baseline, then only last-24-hour changes plus a small bot-brain export. No secrets.

name: First Principles Boss
one_line_desc: A blunt, high-standards boss that pushes you to ship your #1 goal fast: first-principles breakdowns, aggressive weekly targets, daily top-3 check-ins, and a Friday A-F grade.

name: X 曝光复盘助手
one_line_desc: 帮你运营 X 账号的中文助手：每小时写好可直接复制的原创稿，盯大博主和马斯克新帖附评论草稿，监控你的新评论附回复草稿，每晚复盘曝光。所有内容都由你自己手动发。

name: Pour Decisions
one_line_desc: Snap your bar and say who's coming: get cocktails from what you've got, plus a pitcher and a mocktail, scaled to your crowd, with a list of anything missing.

name: Pit Crew
one_line_desc: Pit Crew is your study partner for exactly one exam: it plans, quizzes you, reminds you and tracks your progress. You study and answer, the bot handles all the organizing.

name: Meal Planner
one_line_desc: Weekly menus, aisle-sorted grocery lists, leftovers plans, and allergy or budget tags for households that want less dinner stress. Drafts only — no grocery orders without your KEEP.

name: Pet Care Pal
one_line_desc: For multi-pet households of any mix — dogs, cats, birds, fish, reptiles, small mammals, and more. Builds care sheets covering allergies, sitter notes, grooming, and boarding prefs. Drafts and reminds only; nothing is sent or booked without your KEEP.

name: Caregiving Coordinator
one_line_desc: Helps caregivers and siblings share care: drafts schedules, handoff notes, and supply lists. Nothing goes to the care team without your KEEP.

name: Tess
one_line_desc: Batch-resizes wallpaper images on a Mac to phone 4K size with sips. Paste a folder or file path; it writes non-destructive _4K copies and reports count, path, and DPI.

name: Kindle Courier 2.0.1
one_line_desc: Send a public article, X post or thread, or video URL—or upload a PDF, EPUB or DOCX file. Kindle Courier turns web and video content into EPUBs, forwards uploaded files unchanged, and emails them to your Kindle address.\nCreated by George Hong (@DomainMaster).

name: IRS Demystifier
one_line_desc: A calm, plain-spoken, privacy-first helper for anything involving the IRS: notices and letters, filing, payments, refunds, audits, identity theft, scams, retirement, small businesses, contractors, and nonprofits. Not a substitute for professional tax advice.

name: Gmail Cleanup Chief of Staff
one_line_desc: Finds what's filling your Gmail, lists recurring senders with counts, and safely moves the newsletters, promos and notifications you approve to Trash.

name: Prompt Upgrader
one_line_desc: Paste any rough prompt and get it scored, rewritten, explained and tested, with short and detailed variants ready to copy and paste. Learn better prompting as you go, keep a searchable library of your best prompts, and get an optional daily one-minute tip.

name: Side-Hustle Scout
one_line_desc: No-hype side-hustle, AI monetization & cash-bounty crawler. Scans X, creator platforms, and digital/print-on-demand marketplaces for legitimate low-time income streams—complete with a Scam & Course-Seller Filter, Time-to-First-Dollar scorecard, and an interactive Opportunity Radar Page.

name: HVAC Weekly Digest
one_line_desc: Every Monday, a short HVAC market digest for your service area: weather load, likely call types, parts cues, flat-rate ranges, and a few lead ideas — drafts only. Built for techs, dispatchers, and shop owners.

name: Whoperator
one_line_desc: A sharp SaaS growth operator for Whop creators: pulls live Whop data to show MRR, churn, failed payments, and at-risk members, then gives concrete moves to grow revenue and cut churn. Never changes prices, plans, or memberships, and never messages members, without your yes.

name: Family Schedule Manager
one_line_desc: Your family's week, organized: appointments, school and activity schedules, routines and reminders, and nothing added without your yes.

name: Polyglot Coach
one_line_desc: A language tutor that sends you one short lesson a day built around what you're into, corrects your answers, and plans the next step from your mistakes.

name: Techy
one_line_desc: A friendly IT specialist in your pocket. Techy fixes PC, laptop, phone, Wi-Fi and printer problems step by step in plain English, spots scams, and tracks your warranties and RMA claims.

name: Obsidian Second Brain (official)
one_line_desc: Your Obsidian second brain and memory for note taking and personal knowledge management: turns brain dumps into linked notes, keeps your daily notes, journal and weekly reviews, and remembers for you, answering from your own knowledge base with links to the source notes. Works from a new or existing Obsidian vault or a no-install demo vault, imports Notion, Readwise, X bookmarks and PDFs, and never edits, moves or deletes a note or turns on a routine without your yes.

name: Coffee Bot
one_line_desc: Turns every coffee you try into a full bag on a good-looking shelf Page, ranked by your score out of 5, with recommendations based on your taste. Send a name or a photo of the bag plus a rating.

name: Test Date Coach
one_line_desc: A calm study coach for adults preparing for the GRE, GMAT, LSAT or MCAT. Give it your test date and it builds a daily 15 to 30 minute plan, quizzes you one question at a time, and keeps a list of the topics you keep missing.

name: Rerun Picker
one_line_desc: Rerun Picker (template, read only X bot)

name: Free Trial Reminder
one_line_desc: Catches free trials in your email, warns a few days before they turn into a charge, and cancels them only after you confirm. For anyone who wants fewer surprise charges.

name: Coffee Bot
one_line_desc: A warm coffee companion you visit with to chat about whatever’s on your mind. It listens, remembers the little things, and keeps it a visit, never a help desk.

name: Ernährungs Bot
one_line_desc: Lockerer Kalorien- und Eiweiß-Tracker auf Deutsch: Du sagst, was du isst, er schätzt kcal und Eiweiß, führt ein Tageslog, speichert deine Standardgerichte und schickt Abend-Check und Wochenbericht.

name: Bookmark Librarian
one_line_desc: Turns your messy X bookmarks into a sorted Notion or Google library with topics, summaries and links. It never unbookmarks or posts anything.

name: PostBot
one_line_desc: PostBot reads X for you and sends a short rundown of what’s worth posting about, with real links, talking points and people to talk with. It only reads, so you do all the posting.

name: Opportunity Scout
one_line_desc: Finds freelance leads and remote job openings across X, Reddit, job boards, and bounty sites, then drafts outreach you send yourself. Weekday scans; quiet when nothing new.

name: Student Pilot Coach
one_line_desc: A study coach for student pilots preparing for the FAA Private Pilot Airplane knowledge test and check ride. It builds an ACS-based study plan, writes quizzes and oral-exam scenarios, and tracks weak areas, using official FAA sources only.

name: PAPER TRAIL Guide
one_line_desc: A calm, free helper that walks you step by step through PAPER TRAIL, an app for documenting harassment or stalking, keeping evidence, stopping contact, finding where to report, reviewing protective orders, getting support, and backing up your case. Nothing is sent unless you choose.

name: Househunt
one_line_desc: Guides your whole home search, starting with a clean color-coded map of any US metro that shows average listing prices, property tax, schools, crime, parks, colleges and roads. Then it narrows your areas, finds active listings, keeps a running list of every decision, locates realtors, and helps with tours and offers. Print the map whenever you want.

name: Gift Desk
one_line_desc: Remembers every birthday and anniversary, sends 3 gifts in budget, buys and ships only after you OK the total.

name: PodSum
one_line_desc: Paste a podcast or video link, or attach a recording, and get a full, transcript-grounded brief in chat: hook, sections, real quotes, takeaways, and open questions.

name: Reach Coach
one_line_desc: An honest X growth coach. Audits your account, sharpens your posts, finds smart reply spots, and runs a weekly scoreboard. Never posts for you.

name: Black Friday Bot
one_line_desc: Tracks prices on your wishlist from now through Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Alerts on real drops, flags fake list prices and thinning stock, and spots bundle deals. Paste your own list and budget to start.

name: Polish Pass by Eased
one_line_desc: Polish Pass by Eased opens your page in its own browser at desktop and phone widths, measures what's actually there, and returns a ranked P0/P1/P2 fix list with exact values. It checks motion too: how fast things respond, how dialogs and menus enter and exit, and whether reduced motion is handled. Every review ends with one prompt you can paste into Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable or v0. Made by Eased (eased.dev), a free, MIT, motion-first component library for shadcn. Nothing to set up: it uses its own browser.

name: JAMB Practice Coach
one_line_desc: Turns your JAMB UTME exam date into a daily 15 minute practice plan, quizzes you one question at a time, and keeps a keep-missing list of topics to revisit. Not affiliated with JAMB.
